verdict.rationale: Unit is an API-based financial infrastructure platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence confirms Unit offers APIs and webhooks, but nothing in the pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
